## Payment Reminder Bot
Polite on day 1, firm on day 14, escalated on day 30, without anyone remembering to chase.

Every weekday at 9am it reads open invoices (invoice, client, contact, channel, amount, due_date, status), picks the right reminder stage by days overdue, and sends it on WhatsApp or email. Paid and disputed invoices are skipped; 'final' and 'escalate' stages also alert the account manager.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/payment-reminder-bot
